scope: 12 deterministic supplied-control acceptance cases, not a planner benchmark or original algorithm
effective_radius: body plus frozen0.25m margin for every case
independent_reference: First, middle and last integrated intervals against50-substep independent RK4; atol1e-10m. Every accepted interval keeps frozen curved swept-sphere enclosure.
storage: One compressed numeric record outside repository; compact CSV and JSON publicly. Never overwrite an existing run directory.
stop: Unexpected case outcome or independent integration/certificate mismatch stops acceptance; no random-seed or parameter search. No original planner or mass planning run.
